## Change

F1. Validate required-file MIME token/token syntax before parsed values reach Response Content-Type headers. Preserve existing media top-level restrictions. Reject CRLF-bearing manifest MIME at parser boundary.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral red/green captured. Parent reviewed producer MIME mapping and downstream header sink; reran 108 parser/storage tests. Worker related suite: 132; producer: 23; boundaries: 52 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. MIME parameters remain unsupported; actual producer emits token/token values. No claim MIME proves payload format. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(content): reject unsafe progressive MIME values
